translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: Nying maber oloyo bedo gi mwandu mathoth;
bedo gi pwoch ber moloyo fedha gi dhahabu.
Onge pogruok e kind jamoko kod jachan:
Nikech Jehova Nyasaye e Jachwechgi duto.
Ngʼat mariek neno masira kabiro kendo opondo,
to ngʼat mofuwo dhiyo adhiya nyime ma ohinyre.
Bolruok kod luoro Jehova Nyasaye
kelo mwandu gi luor kod dak amingʼa.
Yore joma timo richo opongʼ gi kudho kod obadho;
to ngʼat morito chunye obedo mabor kodgi.
Puonj nyathi e yo monego odhiye,
to ka obedo maduongʼ to ok obi baro oa kuome.
Jochan gin wasumb jo-mwandu,
to ngʼat moholo gimoro bedo misumba ngʼat mohole.
Ngʼatno mochwowo timbe richo kayo thagruok,
to ludhe mar mirima ibiro ketho.
Ngʼat mangʼwon noyud gweth,
nimar opogo chiembe kod jochan.
Riemb ngʼat ma jaro ji, to lweny bende aa,
dhawo kod kinyruok rumo.
Ngʼat ma chunye ler kendo ma wuoyo gi ngʼwono
biro bedo osiep ruoth.
Wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye rito ngʼeyo;
to orundo weche mag jogo ma ok jo-adiera.
Jasamuoyo wacho niya, “Sibuor ni oko!”
Kata, “Ibiro nega e yore mag dala!”
Dho dhako ma jachode en bur matut;
ngʼatno manie bwo mirimb Jehova Nyasaye biro lingʼore e iye.
Fuwo otwere e chuny nyathi,
to ludh kum biro riembe mabor kode.
Ngʼat mathiro jochan mondo mwandune omedre
kod ngʼat machiwo mich ne jomoko biro bedo jochan.
Chik iti kendo iwinj weche mag jomariek;
ket chunyi ne gima apuonjo,
nimar en mor ka ikanogi ei chunyi
kendo bed kodgi moikore e dhogi.
Mondo omi ibed gi geno kuom Jehova Nyasaye;
apuonji tinendeni, in bende.
Donge asendikoni weche mowachi piero adek,
weche mag puonj kod ngʼeyo,
mapuonjou adiera gi weche migeno,
mondo ichiw dwoko mowinjore ne ngʼat mane oori?
Kik ima jachan nikech gin jochan
kendo kik ihiny joma ochando man-gi dwaro e kar bura,
nimar Jehova Nyasaye biro chwako buchgi,
kendo tieko ngima joma tieko ngimagi.
Kik imak osiep gi ngʼat ma iye wangʼ piyo;
kik iriwri bende gi ngʼatno makecho piyo,
dipo nono ka ipuonjori yorene,
ma iwuon idonj e obadho.
Kik ibed ngʼatno matimo singruok
kata machungʼ ne ngʼato e gope;
ka ionge gi yo kaka dichul,
nono to wuon gowino nyalo kawo kitandani.
Kik igol kidi mar kiewo machon
mane oket gi kweregi.
Bende ineno ngʼat molony e tije?
Obiro tiyo ne ruodhi,
ok onyal tiyo ne ji ma ok ongʼere.
